definitions.comparisons: same original target and same bitmap truth in all four crop/paste cells
definitions.inference: no statistical confidence or learned AP inferred from target-level descriptive means
definitions.mask_boundary: at least one foreground pixel on first/last source image row or column
definitions.mean_iou: equal target weight among defined union>0; undefined and source/predicted empties retained
definitions.oracle: GT bitmap binary node samples at >=.5; stock bilinear paste then >.5; GT original boxes
definitions.roi_boundary: at least one original le90 vertex outside continuous [0,width]x[0,height]
